These Improved versions of stuff like this and the Gae Bulg are making it quite clear that KOEI is saying high end adventurers that do the quests to get the in-game obtainable versions of them are no longer needed. IGN: CullumStraun

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
MMOs will always favor those who invest their money in it. While I'm glad that means UWO will continue to turn a profit and remain online for us to play, things like that are one of the many reasons I've always loathed MMOs and avoided them like the plague.

On the other hand, adventure quests give you the weapons in question with a 100% success rate. The recycle bottle requires a good deal of sacrifice (5 bottle items for one recycle item), and who knows what the drop rates are for something this powerful. Well, we'll see how it goes - I'm glad OGP is at least trying to find a way to balance things out for everyone's benefit.

comments.author: Curious
comments.body:
You should specify "F2P" MMO's :P

It's not like this sort of thing hasn't been seen already. Oh, you played for a few years and you can finally sail a Cruise High Clipper, the fastest ship in the game? Well too bad, here's a Celebratory High Clipper, NEW fastest ship in the game for a much lower level requirement, that can be yours for $200 or 15b ducats. Lets not forget the speed up pendants that have Tow Cutters outrunning Xebec Cruisers...

As a primary Adventurer myself, I'm kind of on the fence about the Excalibur deal. I can see pros and cons on both sides. There's nothing I can do to change the situation so there's no reason for me to get upset over it. It is what it is...
